book.name: Mataio
book.title: Bais ula mumuru la omirong Mataio aime Iesu

content: Teip o agat la ogimameng marala ga mumaio agimameng Iesu

Urie, Maria la avarangeieng Iesu toma na pianam Betilem na provins Iudaia, na irie tara Herot la orongong. Tie, non teip o agat ula muru onim toma la ime bet muabari la mumaio Ierusalem ga mamarikmeng tapmat gare ro,
“Kulot ila nei la betong meba orong ang me gar onim Israel, lagum la unama? Ogimapang marala ang toma na nap la ime bet muabari, ga mupo meba lotupang me ai.”
Urie, orong Herot la upto uriro ties ga turupuaba kirat. Ga papot ma teip ga magaulap onim Ierusalem la mepto uriro ties ga mirie gat la turupmaiaba kirat.
Are ratmat ga upamuam Herot mirier miridaip ganam mila uke ga teip mila omeit maimai ga mamarikong, “Iriro migana Karisito, naga ang eba avarangeieng na man pianam?”
Mepulo ties gare ro, “Eba avarangeieng na pianam ula kapio Betilem na provins Iudaia. Are unuli Maika la omirong ties gare ro,

content.text: “‘Mimi teip ga magaulap onim Betilem na provins Iudaia, Betilem la tale pianam ula kapio agarit kabirana ma taunup mila kakanim la maionama Iudaia. Karuk kan.
Memani, eba betang noba migana ila kakani kabirana mi gare migana o unuleap ma sipsipup ga eba ualeng bo gar ruang Israel.’” Maika 5:2

content: Urie, Herot la upto uriro ties ga mamarikong tigit miriro teip o agat mila magimameng maralaip meba mumaiong ai. Ga mamarikong a man tara la betieng marala ga ogimameng.
Ga masagaong ga mela na pianam Betilem ga maulo, “Mila ga ubiming maranit le asinming iriro kulot. Ga leba amioping, tie eba ina mumiong ga tomilava. Meba gat tala loturang me ai.”
Herot la maulo ra, tie teip o agat la mela. Pa uriro marala, tinan la ogimameng na nap la ime bet muabari la ike maime ga ila dusieng bo luguan la unama kulot ana.
Ogimameng marala la dusieng ga mitara temeba.
Are ratmat ga maiobu na luguan, ga agimameng kulot ga naga ang Maria. Ga kumumeng ga makofmeng dadebip ma ga maialo kamniap maiong aun. Gol ga urup mila kukufmeng ga sada.
Pa na non kikiritniap, Morowa la maulo, “Baraba gat ina mila Ierusalem ga agimaming Herot.” Are ratmat ga omeuluo non alang ga mela na lakuan maiong.
Iosep ga Maria ga Iesu la igomeng ga mela Isip.

Teip o agat la mela ra. Urie, non angelo ang Ila Kakani la betong ai Iosep na kikiritniap. Ga ugama, “Tenara ga alaginang kulot ga naga ang, ga igomig ga mila Isip. Ga mionang Isip puoieng na tara leba miralava gat meba ina terigiming. Herot la namo aisinang Iesu meba anamung ga aving.”
Are ratmat ga teuara Iosep kabirana o arubu, ga alagiong kulot Iesu ga naga ang ga igomeng ga mela Isip.
Urie, unama Iosep Isip puoieng la uvara Herot, eva uriro la ovuoieng non ties ang Ila Kakani la uaramo na nanam a unuli Hosia la tiesong gare ro,

content.text: “Poi ruang la unama Isip ga amariktung ga oulai Isip ga muo.” Hosia 11:1

content: Herot la maulo teip o danunumiap ga menamuam papot ma lop mila teip ga mevara.

Urie, Herot la mait ara teip mila magimameng maralaip la avanameng ara ga tale gat ina mumaio agimameng. Are ratmat ga mitara papamnam dalap a kirat, ga masagaong non teip o danunumiap am ga mela na taun Betilem ga na tatak pialap la maiot u ga menamuam mirier lop ganam ga mirie mila tale ka narain karaipien maiangan. Memani, maagatong miriro pagap teip mila magimameng maralaip la amelo ma na tara la mamarikong.
Miriro pagap la betmeng meba opuomeng ties ang unuli Ieremia la uaramo tinan. La tiesieng gare ro,

content.text: “Inamaniap la mepto nulibap la betieng Rama. Meptam magaulap la meliba ga kukupmeng un kadik. Magaulap a gar iang Resel la meliba me lop maiam. Pa tale kan puomeng teip ga magaulap meba maidangmeng dalap ma. Memani, karuk kan maime lop maiam, pa mevara ra.” Ieremia 31:15

content: Iosep ga magabun ga kulot la inar terigimeng Israel
Urie, tara la uvara ra Herot, tie betong angelo ang Ila Kakani ai Iosep na kikiritniap na tara la unama Isip ga aulo,
“Tenara ga alaginang poi nuang ga naga ang, ga ina mila Israel. Teip la namo menamung kulot Iesu la mevara ra.”
Urie, teuara Iosep ga alagiong kulot Iesu ga naga ang ga inar mela Israel.

Tie, betong ara Iosep Israel ga upto ties gare ro, “Arkilao la aigorula mamo ang a Herot, ga orongong na provins Iudaia.” Are ratmat ga urau Iosep ga tale ga eba ala onang na uriro provins. Pa na arubu Morowa la inagat asagaong angelo na non kikiritniap ga ualo ties aun Iosep.

Are ratmat ga mela maionama na pianam bonim o Nasaret, are Morowa la tiesong tinan na nanamup ma non unulip la betieng ga iario parak. La tiesieng gare ro, “Eva, eba meivang inamaniap irie, migana onim Nasaret.”

footnotes.text: Gol la avuoong migana leba betang gare orong. Urup mila kukufmeng avuomeng lavang la akosarmeng miridaip. Sada la meiva gat “Mira.” Ovuoong ubi leba okosarang Iesu iro maiogun.
